Chapter 1227 - 35: The Invincible Lin Yuan (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1227: Chapter 35: The Invincible Lin Yuan (Please Subscribe)

Lin Yuan’s gaze was distant, his tone calm, but his words startled the Red Flame Venerable.

Just push through?

What does that mean?

Push through?

Who to push through?

Someone like Fu Xu Venerate, the Strongest Venerable?

Lin Yuan’s strength was indeed unfathomable, at the same level as the Strongest Venerable of the Six Ancient Countries.

But Fu Xu Venerate was also the Strongest Venerable, even if there was a gap between them, it wasn’t large, so how could he push through?

Besides Fu Xu Venerate, Xuanyin Ancient Country, Da Ling Ancient Country, Thunderclap Ancient Country, and other top Peak Venerables, wielding ancient countries’ powerful relics, could explode with battle power not much weaker than the Strongest Venerable.

With so many obstacles, how could the Galaxy Venerate push through them?

The Red Flame Venerable couldn’t comprehend it.

In his view, the Strongest Venerable was already the strongest below the Ancestor, wanting to push through such a strong being, perhaps only the high-up Ancestor could.

But Lin Yuan clearly hadn’t reached the Ancestor realm.

...

The Red Flame Venerable looked at Lin Yuan, his expression filled with uncertainty.

If these words hadn’t come from Lin Yuan, he wouldn’t have thought so much, because he simply wouldn’t believe it.

Lin Yuan did not explain further, just waved a hand, and a ’map’ of the treasure ground appeared before them.

This newly born treasure ground was vast and expansive, with a deep breadth of space-time.

But after one or two thousand years of exploration by the Peak Venerables of the Six Ancient Countries, a precise ’map’ was basically drawn.

The map was dotted with over three hundred points of light.

Among them, three points were larger than the others.

The ordinary points of light were the core pillars within the treasure ground.

The larger points of light were the giant core pillars.

The Red Flame Venerable also saw the ’map’ of the treasure ground conjured by Lin Yuan.

Although each core pillar’s precise space-time location coordinates were marked.

Due to the special nature of the core pillars—the Heavenly Venerate refining the pillar could instantly appear beside it.

This made ambushes meaningless; any disturbance would cause the top Peak Venerable occupying the core pillar to descend instantly.

Moreover, a certain ancient country’s top Peak Venerable would usually hold the country’s powerful relic, capable of exploding with battle power close to the Strongest Venerable in crucial moments.

The Man Kun Venerable from the Barbaric Wilderness Country refined the second giant core pillar, and though Fu Xu Venerate was furious, he could only retreat.

This was partly due to Lin Yuan’s threat and Fu Xu Venerate’s uncertainty about breaking through Man Kun Venerable’s defense quickly.

The ancient countries’ powerful relics were terrifying, originating from the Ancestor; when top Peak Venerables exerted their full strength, their capabilities would surge, making the Strongest Venerable wary.

"Let’s start here."

Lin Yuan looked at the ’map’ of the treasure ground for a while, finally choosing a core pillar in a corner.

Starting here to push through could radiate to the entire treasure ground in the shortest time.

"Come with me."

Lin Yuan glanced at the Red Flame Venerable.

"Yes."

The Red Flame Venerable’s face was puzzled; he vaguely sensed what Lin Yuan intended to do, found it hard to believe, but still nodded in response.

Whoosh.

Space-time twisted.

In just a fleeting moment.

Lin Yuan brought the Red Flame Venerable to the core pillar in the corner.

"Such speed of space-time traversal..."

The Red Flame Venerable was shocked in his heart; from the giant core pillar to here, although it wasn’t half the treasure ground apart, it was at least a tenth of the treasure ground’s distance.

Even a Strongest Venerable like Fu Xu Venerate would need at least a fraction of a breath to traverse such a distance out of thin air.

Yet Lin Yuan only took an instant?

And he brought him along?

"Galaxy Venerate?"

Before the core pillar, a figure materialized, cautiously watching Lin Yuan.

This core pillar was occupied by the Thunderclap Ancient Country, and the one descending now was the top Peak Venerable of Thunderclap Ancient Country, named Leisa Venerate.

"Galaxy Venerate, my Thunderclap Ancient Country has already completed a transaction with Fu Xu Venerate, you’re too late."

Leisa Venerate stared at Lin Yuan and immediately said this.

He thought Lin Yuan had come to negotiate for the core pillar they occupied and refined.

"No matter."

Lin Yuan looked at Leisa Venerate, casually took a step forward.

Rumble.

A vast power of space-time crushed forward.

...

The second giant core pillar.

Twelve Peak Venerables of the Barbaric Wilderness Country gathered here.

"Has Da Fu Ancient Country reached a deal with Xuanyin Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country?"

The top Peak Venerable, Man Kun Venerable of the Barbaric Wilderness Country, immediately felt troubled.

These three ancient countries stood together, plus the Thunderclap Ancient Country, which always followed the lead of Da Fu Ancient Country, now Da Fu’s control of core pillars exceeded two-thirds of all the core pillars in the entire treasure ground.

"Galaxy Venerate did not reach an agreement with Da Ling Ancient Country and Xuanyin Ancient Country?"

Another top Peak Venerable from the Barbaric Wilderness Country said.

Not to mention Thunderclap Ancient Country, which was tacitly said to stand by Da Fu Ancient Country.

But Da Ling Ancient Country and Xuanyin Ancient Country, it was entirely possible to negotiate, as long as the price was high enough, it was believed they could be swayed.

Thus they would qualify to compete with Da Fu Ancient Country.

"Perhaps they demanded too much?"

The third top Peak Venerable spoke, even without knowing the specifics of the negotiations between Da Ling Xuanyin and Galaxy Venerate.

But anyone could guess these two ancient countries would make exorbitant demands.

"It’s a pity these two ancient countries don’t even entertain the thought of discussing with my Thunderclap Ancient Country." The second speaking top Peak Venerable expressed some helplessness.

Whether it’s Da Ling Ancient Country or Xuanyin Ancient Country, the entire time they considered Da Fu Ancient Country and Fierce Sun Ancient Country?

As for Thunderclap Ancient Country?
